Follow all rules defined in:

- [Common Unit Test Rules](../instructions/unit-test-common.instructions.md)
- [React Unit Test Rules](../instructions/react-unit-test.instructions.md)

Generate or update Jest unit tests for the React code provided in the current context.

Treat all referenced unit test rules as mandatory.

Use the provided component, hook, function, or module as the primary context.
If a corresponding test file already exists, update it instead of creating a duplicate.

Inspect additional files only when necessary to produce correct tests.

Do not run tests.
Do not modify production code.
